item.title: BondMedia 0.2.4
item.description: - Series pages: seasons are now the heading of the episode list, with a count of episodes left. Hide Spoilers moved into the ⋯ menu. - Download Season is a round button next to Favorites and shows which season it will download. - Smoother scrolling through long episode lists. - The timeline's time preview now floats above the bar instead of covering it; the bar thickens less on hover. - Library grids no longer hide their last column, and the A–Z bar stays clear of always-visible scroll bars. - Clearer buffer settings: the values are minimums (files with rare keyframes buffer further ahead). - Tooltips on Play, Resume and Trailer.

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.3
item.description:
• New compact player controls with volume and 10-second skips
  • The timeline's time bubble no longer covers the bar
  • The sidebar always opens and widens fully, with nothing cut off
  • No dark band over the Home hero when the pointer reaches the toolbar

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.2
item.description: • The sidebar can be made as narrow as before again

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.1
item.description:
• The Play/Resume button on series pages is now translated
  • English is used when macOS is set to neither English nor Russian
  • Sidebar labels no longer get cut off

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.0
item.description:
• Automatic updates
  • Offline downloads
  • Up Next with a watchlist
  • Your chosen dub is remembered for the whole series
  • Sleep timer
  • Episode pages with file details
  • Instant movie pages and actor biographies
